purpose: Track the four highest-value observation areas during the hackathon. These are the likely sources of authority drift.

risks.name: MCP Capability Drift
risks.description: A new tool gets added quickly without a clear authority boundary
risks.prevention: Capability review before adding new MCP tools

risks.name: Database Authority Drift
risks.description: A dashboard or UI layer begins treating cached/projection data as truth
risks.prevention: Clear ownership map for DB tables

risks.name: Evidence Erosion
risks.description: Receipts become incomplete because the demo needs speed

risks.name: AI-Generated Architectural Drift
risks.description: An agent creates a convenient abstraction that becomes an accidental authority source
risks.prevention: Authority surface audit during code review

monitoring_approach.escalation: If any risk detected, stop and classify before proceeding
